scenes.heading: TikTok Shop Affiliate — The Fastest-Growing Opportunity

sents.d: TikTok Shop Affiliate — The Fastest-Growing Opportunity
How TikTok Shop's affiliate program works and how to start earning from short-form video.
TikTok Shop lets creators earn commissions by showcasing products directly inside TikTok videos.
The buyer never leaves the app — they see the product, tap, and buy.
This removes the biggest friction point in affiliate marketing (getting someone to click away to another site).
Conversion rates are significantly higher than traditional affiliate links.
Open TikTok → Profile → TikTok Shop → "Start earning." You need at least 1,000 followers to access the affiliate features (5,000 for some product categories).
Once approved, browse the marketplace for products, add them to your showcase, and create videos featuring them.
The yellow shopping bag icon appears on your videos automatically.
Sellers set their own commission rates — typically 10-30% for most products.
Some run special campaigns with higher rates to get initial reviews.
You earn when someone buys through your video or your product showcase page.
TikTok handles all payment processing and sends your earnings to your linked bank account.

scenes.heading: Content That Sells on TikTok Shop

sents.d: "I found this on TikTok Shop" hauls, honest product reviews, before-and-after demonstrations, "things you didn't know you needed" compilations, and problem-solution videos.
The key: make content about the RESULT the product delivers, not the product itself.
"How I fixed my dry skin" beats "Buy this moisturizer."
Post 1-2 shop videos per day minimum.
Pin your best-converting videos.
Engage with every comment (the algorithm rewards it).
Use trending sounds.
Film with good lighting.
Show the product being used, not just sitting on a table.
Respond to "where did you get that?" comments with a link.
Stack multiple products in one video when they're related.

take: Show products in use with short, honest videos.
